name: bg1
prompt: Create a calm portrait mobile-game room background, 1500:2500 aspect ratio. Quiet forest: deep desaturated teal-green atmosphere, very simple broad rounded tree canopy silhouettes confined to the top corners and upper 35%, gentle cool light through the upper centre. The lower 60% stays a smooth dark green gradient with no trunks, foliage, floor objects or edges crossing it. Style: restrained vector-like storybook environment, very broad rounded shapes and soft smooth gradients, calm premium palette, minimal detail and no texture. Should complement simple gradient-based sunset, starry-night, ocean and blossom game rooms. Panda and glass UI will be overlaid in the lower 60%, so keep that region calm and low contrast. Fully opaque edge-to-edge background, no transparency, no text, no characters, no props, no furniture, no hard geometric ribbons, no visible ground shadow or platform, no photographic detail, no vignette black border.
